root_idea.summary: The root's basic orientation is spreading, scattering, and flying apart. Its principal lexical branches include evil as the opposite of good and sparks flying from fire.
root_idea.development: The same image extends to sparks, cutting or separating, spreading things out to dry, scattered herds, and figurative concentration of one's scattered aims or whole self upon something.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized noun شَرَر for the Quranic meaning of sparks.
Displayed under the standard noun شَرّ, including its substantivized, comparative, and superlative uses.

senses.definition: Evil, badness, wrongdoing, injustice, corruption, or harmful misfortune; also a person or group characterized by such qualities.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as an abstract noun for what is opposed to good, and substantivally for bad or evil people. The context may specify moral evil, physical harm, or an evil condition.
Used comparatively with مِنْ for “worse than,” and in superlative or elliptical constructions for “the worst.”

senses.definition: A spark or sparks flying from a fire.
senses.usage_conditions: A noun for fiery particles emitted and scattered from a flame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become evil, wicked, unjust, corrupt, mischievous, or depraved; also to increase in evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I verb describing a person’s becoming or growing worse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame, find fault with, or charge someone with a vice, defect, or other fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I construction taking the person blamed or charged as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread something in the sun, or lay it out to dry; also to sprinkle salt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of garments, cloth, food, salt, and similar things placed on a mat or other surface for drying or treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone notorious or infamous among people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative/intensive verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act evilly or hostilely toward someone, contend or dispute with him, or do him evil that obliges a reciprocal response.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction describing hostile interaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attribute or impute evil, wrongdoing, injustice, or a fault to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV construction; its usage is reported with some grammatical disagreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To banish or drive someone away, leaving him alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Form IV usage in the plural verbal form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manifest, reveal, publish, or make something known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported tropical usage, with the cited poetic attribution itself treated as tentative in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel or other cloven-hoofed animal, to ruminate or chew the cud.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII animal-related usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become the possessor of a great herd of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X usage associated with a herd called إِشْرَارَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To split, cleave, or cut something into many pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reduplicated Form I usage describing extensive cutting or division.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bite and then shake an object; of a serpent, to bite someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object bitten may be a thing or a person; the serpent construction specifically denotes biting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For livestock to eat vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive animal construction with herbage as the consumed vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sharpen or rub a knife against a stone so that its edge becomes rough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction describing treatment of a knife edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a bird to expand and flap its wings without alighting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive bird-related usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become separated or scattered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V-like reflexive/intransitive usage describing dispersal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poverty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported tropical extension of the noun’s lexical range.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported tropical extension of the noun’s lexical range.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Evil One, namely Iblis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional epithet referring specifically to Iblis.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vice, fault, defect, blemish, or thing disapproved of, disliked, or hated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct vocalized noun for an objectionable defect or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inordinate desire or eagerness, youthful sprightliness, sharpness, or anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may describe energetic eagerness generally, including the idiom of eagerness for something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or shore of a sea or great river, or the area near it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal usage, with a plural referring also to seas or great rivers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of tree that grows in a sea or great river.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported botanical usage attributed to some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large iron needle or bodkin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized concrete noun for a large needle used as a مِسَلَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Emitting many sparks; a fire that throws off many sparks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjective applied especially to fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Certain small insects resembling gnats that cover a person’s face without biting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal regional term, reported for the people of al-Sawad.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abounding in evil or wrongdoing; very evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjective applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert plant that spreads along the ground in long, rope-like growths.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun for a known plant of the desert plain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roasted meat from which the grease or gravy drips.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive expression for dripping roasted meat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fringe-like extremity of a tail or wing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually encountered in the plural شَرَاشِر for projecting or dangling extremities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The whole body, self, weight, or burdens carried by a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural usage, especially in the expression أَلْقَى عَلَيْهِ شَرَاشِرَهُ, “he cast his whole self or weight upon it.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intense desire, eagerness, or love directed toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiomatic usage describing complete absorption or devotion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or fragment of anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for an individual piece.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small dust-colored bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional bird name, especially associated with the Hijaz and desert Arabs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who greatly imputes vices, faults, or similar defects to others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine usage of the comparative-related form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mat, cloth, or tablet on which curd, meat, or other food is spread to dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete drying surface; its plural may also denote strips of meat cut and dried.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great herd of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun explained as referring to a scattered herd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet derived from biting and shaking its prey.

cautions: The Lane and Maqayis evidence is indexed under the contracted heading شر, while the canonical QAC root is the geminate root شرر.
The Quranic شَرّ group includes ordinary evil, substantivized bad people, and comparative or superlative contexts; English renderings therefore vary between “evil,” “bad,” “worse,” and “worst.”
The reported Form IV meaning “to reveal or publish” is marked as tropical and accompanied by a disputed poetic reading; it is retained as a Classical meaning rather than treated as Quranic evidence.
